roster.provenance: Ordered sample columns extracted verbatim from the #CHROM header of the pinned mirrored HGSVC/HPRC Y1 chr22 VCF.
roster.intended_use: Authoritative ordered Y1 HGSVC/HPRC metadata roster.

derived_from_vcf.provenance: HGSVC/HPRC gnomAD Long Read Y1 chr22 VCF mirrored from Broad workspace bucket fc-fd42e80c-b41e-4e60-a9cf-b7c0ade168c4; identity recorded by gnomad-browser commit 510f8ea18.
derived_from_vcf.intended_use: Source of the ordered sample roster only. Carrier-derived sample discovery is forbidden.

primary_hprc.license: HPRC data use and repository terms; see upstream repository
primary_hprc.provenance: Immutable mirror of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/human-pangenomics/hprc_intermediate_assembly/568298a358c35dc9930be71519e472f33aebc1e6/data_tables/sample/hprc_release2_sample_metadata.csv, maintained by the Human Pangenome Reference Consortium.
primary_hprc.intended_use: Primary sample metadata and fine-grained population assignment.

supplemental_ancestry.license: MIT license of the pinned gnomad-browser repository revision
supplemental_ancestry.provenance: HGSVC/HPRC continental ancestry labels imported to gnomad-browser by Matthew Solomonson in commit 64de6d2e81f3a06b4382f78f6e732e595b44d638. Scientific labels are consumed as provided; Population and color are documented placeholders and are ignored.
supplemental_ancestry.intended_use: Supplement only missing or unrecognized primary superpopulation assignments; never supply subpopulation, color, sex, collection, or descriptor.
